title: Harness Skill Frontmatter (L2 knowledge layer)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. The body after the frontmatter is free-form guidance.

stage.description: Workflow stage this skill serves. 'intake'/'analysis'/'implementation'/'test'/'verification'/'qa-gate' are the DAG stage ids in contracts/workflow.yaml; the others are broader lifecycle phases. 'implement' is a legacy alias of 'implementation'. The 3-stage DAG (analysis/implementation/verification) stays valid — v1.6.0 adds stages, it does not retire any.
